subject: CloudOps procurement kickoff: SLA & support onboarding checklist
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Thompson <sarah.thompson@cloudops.com>
Cc: procurement@cloudops.com
Date: Mon, 08 Sep 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: CloudOps procurement kickoff: SLA & support onboarding checklist

Hi Sarah,

Thanks again for taking the call last week. Procurement here at Redwood is starting the vendor setup for CloudOps so we can kick off the private deployment evaluation next month. To keep things moving, can you please complete and return the attached SLA/support checklist (see file SLA_Support_Checklist_CloudOps.xlsx) and confirm the following items: 

- Primary/secondary support contacts (names, roles, phone/pager, and escalation emails)
- Standard support hours and on-call coverage for P1 incidents
- Target uptime/availability SLOs (monthly and annual targets) and any planned maintenance windows
- Incident response SLAs (P1/P2/P3 initial response and resolution expectations)
- Point of contact for security/compliance evidence requests (SOC 2, audit logs access)
- Billing & PO process: who receives POs, invoicing cadence, and required PO fields

We generally aim for a 2–3 week onboarding window for basic connectivity and verification; if you can outline any dependencies we should plan for, that would help align schedules.

I’ve attached our Redwood_Vendor_Onboarding_Template.pdf to illustrate the fields we’ll need on your side. Can you also propose 30-minute slots for a kickoff call this week or next?

Appreciate it — we want to make onboarding as frictionless as possible.

Best,

Laura Bennett
Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com
---
Attachments: Redwood_Vendor_Onboarding_Template.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Sarah Thompson <sarah.thompson@cloudops.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 08 Sep 2025 09:36:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CloudOps procurement kickoff: SLA & support onboarding checklist

Hi Laura — thanks for the clear checklist. I’ve attached the completed SLA_Support_Checklist_CloudOps.xlsx and our DataProcessing_Addendum.pdf. Key items below for quick reference: 

- Uptime / availability: 99.95% monthly SLA, target 99.99% annual (exceptions for scheduled maintenance with 48h notice)
- Support hours: 24x7 for Sev1 incidents; business hours (Mon–Fri 8am–6pm PT) for Sev2/3 with on-call rotation for after-hours Sev2 as needed
- Response targets (initial): P1 = 15 minutes, P2 = 60 minutes, P3 = 8 business hours
- Escalation path: primary support inbox support@cloudops.com; P1 pager for on-call engineer (+1-415-555-0134); escalation manager: Mark Reyes (mark.reyes@cloudops.com)
- Security contact: Jenna Alvarez (security@cloudops.com) for SOC2 evidence and logging requests
- Billing/PO: Please send POs to invoices@cloudops.com; invoice net30; include Redwood PO# and billing contact (see attached instructions if your AP team needs a template)

Kickoff availability: Tue 2025-09-09 10:00–10:30 PT or Wed 2025-09-10 14:00–14:30 PT — I can make either.

We’ve also created a DocuSign envelope for the Master Services Agreement if you’re ready: https://docusign.com/envelope/ABC123-CloudOps-MSA

Thanks — I’ll upload the checklist to our vendor portal once we have the Redwood PO on file.

—Sarah
Sarah Thompson
Head of Vendor Partnerships | CloudOps Inc
sarah.thompson@cloudops.com
---
Attachments: SLA_Support_Checklist_CloudOps.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet), DataProcessing_Addendum.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Thompson <sarah.thompson@cloudops.com>
Cc: dev_patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 08 Sep 2025 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CloudOps procurement kickoff: SLA & support onboarding checklist

Hi Sarah — this is great, thanks for the fast turnaround and the clarity on SLAs. Looping in our Finance/PO owner Dev Patel and our Customer Onboarding lead Marissa Cole to align on PO and technical onboarding. A few follow-ups: 

- Dev: please confirm the PO number and billing contact we should include when we send the vendor PO. We usually include a Redwood PO# and require invoices to reference it for net30 payment. I’ve attached Redwood_PO_Instructions.pdf for your reference.
- Marissa: can you confirm the expected timeline for connectivity validation and whether 2–3 weeks still looks reasonable on your end given CloudOps’ stated support and maintenance windows? Also please note the P1 response SLA and pager contact — want to ensure our runbook maps to their escalation flow.

Proposed next steps:
1) Dev issues PO to invoices@cloudops.com (cc: procurement inbox)
2) CloudOps returns signed onboarding form (SLA checklist accepted)
3) Kickoff call to review firewall/ip allowlist and SSO integration (30 min)

Suggested kickoff times from Sarah above look good to me — I can do Tue 9/9 10:00 PT if that works for everyone.

Best,
Laura
Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com
---
